definitions.center_center: Euclidean robot-center displacement between paired trajectories or robot-center to goal distance.
definitions.center_segment: Reported clearing_distance_min uses robot-center distance to sampled obstacle points; no robot radius subtraction. It is not swept footprint clearance.
definitions.surface_clearance: Pedestrian center distance minus the 1.0 m robot and 0.4 m pedestrian radii; no second radius subtraction.

review_status: Requires evidence review; these declarations do not admit results.
